PTM-WEB combines PTM knowledge with interactive protein views.
Domain Graph adds a residue-scale view beside the existing network.

text:
Domain annotations and PTM sites are both expressed in residue coordinates.

Placing them on one scale makes their positions and nearby regions visible at a glance.

The graph is an exploration aid; biological interpretation still depends on annotation evidence.
